title: A Numerically-safe Branch-Price-and-Cut Algorithm for the Length-Constrained Cycle Partition Problem
summary: The length-constrained cycle partition problem (LCCP) is a graph optimization problem in which a set of nodes must be partitioned into a minimum number of cycles. Every node is associated with a critical time and the length of every cycle must not exceed the critical time of any node in the cycle. We formulate LCCP as a set partitioning model and solve it using an exact branch-price-and-cut approach. Our dynamic programming-based pricing algorithm to generate improving cycles exploits the particular structure of the pricing problem for efficient bidirectional search and symmetry breaking.…
